notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
description:
Activate Serra's Sanctum by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Serra's Sanctum.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Candelabra of Tawnos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {1}.
Repeat.
